evidenceVisibilityFindings: K13 and S7 replicate the S9/K10 false-gap pattern once Group teaching + CEA + Gateway are admitted.
B5 shows the opposite: SOW focus-tags can claim behaviour coverage without content — visibility of tags ≠ teaching.
Workplace job-card axis remains weak across almost all KSBs (referenced, not artefact-supplied).
S11/K28 gaps are not visibility illusions under strict requirement reading.
contradictionsConflicts: W11 lists B5 in focus line while body content is customer-service scenarios without inclusive-workplace teaching — intent tagging conflict.
G08 payments/VAT/GDPR/fraud can look like 'financial compliance' but fails strict K28 FCA/PCI requirement.
S11 can be mistakenly saturated by EV isolation/awareness (S13/K21/K23) — must stay separated.
S10 breadth vs one-Primary product rule remains a structural product tension, not an evidence failure.

confidenceByEvidenceAxis.teachingJudgements: HIGH for K13/K11/S10/S11/K28/B5 within corpus; MEDIUM-HIGH for S7 skill vs K2 schedule depth split
confidenceByEvidenceAxis.practiceJudgements: HIGH where CEA/Gateway instruments exist; HIGH gap calls for S11/B5/K28

proves: False curriculum gaps from SOW-only visibility recur outside tyre/steering (K13, S7)
True gaps survive strict reading (S11, K28, B5)
Distributed ownership pattern holds under richer evidence (S10)
Behaviour KSBs can be assessed without forcing technical practical templates (B5)
disproves: That richer corpus always dissolves Golden A gaps
That Gateway assessment alone should set Primary ownership
methodologyValidation.confidenceToScaleToward64: INCREASED for continued patterned shadow review; NOT sufficient alone for trusted Golden B / programme-truth write

stillGenuinelyMissing: Explicit FCA/PCI teaching artefact (if exists outside corpus)
Explicit EDI/inclusive workplace teaching artefact (if delivered off-pack)
HV battery/charger SoH practical procedure + assessment
